tools.name: estimateQuarterlyTax
tools.description: Estimate US federal + state quarterly estimated tax payments for a self-employed person. Given annual Schedule C net profit, filing status, two-letter US state code, tax year, and whether the §199A QBI deduction applies, returns annual federal income+SE tax, rough state income tax, SE tax, combined

tools.name: getPaymentCalendar
tools.description: Return the 4 federal quarterly estimated tax payment due dates for a tax year (Apr/Jun/Sep 15 and Jan 15 of the following year, rolled forward past weekends and IRS holidays to the real deadline), plus a deep link to the site. Read-only.
